scope: Readback of pre-integration 40a CI observations; not a native run or qualification of the root's new integrated source or Hepta V8 pair.

verification.reader_claim_boundary: Existing strict readers check record/byte consistency; CI receipts bind source/build/ELF identity. No new cryptographic transcript replay, physical-host attestation, or independent operator claim.

actual_reuse_v3.coverage: Nine material classes, frozen 13 arms, eight actual preparation cohorts, four actual searches per supported cohort; every unsupported cell and miss retained.
actual_reuse_v3.selection: One supplied fixed arm over its whole eight-cohort class; all four artifacts select the same arm per class. Not per-sample fastest selection or a global lower bound.
actual_reuse_v3.cost_scope: Inclusive preparation, all complete attempts/searches, trial retention, hashing/hex and allocation; common material generation and native verification separate; JSON emission and whole-node/network/M06/settlement excluded.

fixed_factorial_sensitivity.fixed_comparison: eager-transposed CPU / lazy-full-limb CPU for matched whole cohorts at the same task, target, complete nonce stream, and exact winning proofs
assumptions: q is a hypothetical fraction of one additive CPU resource, not measured network share, host quota, service receiver budget, or sixteen-worker count.
Linear valid-work throughput, same hardware within each paired comparison, equal task/target distribution, equal availability, no extra network or hardware advantage.
The measured s is producer-only finite CPU cost, not a bound on accepted whole-node work rate or the fastest legal adversary.
Equal targets cancel expected credited-work efficiency. Unequal targets require eta_A/eta_H as already defined in WORK_COST_DAA_BOUNDARIES; do not double-count if s is already credited-work rate.
fixed_factorial_sensitivity.cost_scope: One real preparation per cohort plus all full transcripts/tickets, failed attempts, materializations and binary-trial retention. Shared material setup, evidence digests/JSON, native verification and final retained-buffer destruction are separate. No modeled setup division.
fixed_factorial_sensitivity.cross_horizon_scope: 1/8/64 reuse horizons share search prefixes; observations must not be summed as independent searches or credited work.

invalid_input_amplification.definition: Full production rejection CPU / complete from-zero false-producer cohort CPU including its real preparation and every trial; neither last-winning-hash CPU nor valid-proof acquisition is substituted.
invalid_input_amplification.scope: Primitive receiver rejection timing; full malformed-frame, PQ, admission, M06 and durable settlement amplification remain separate obligations.
invalid_input_amplification.kernel_independence: Production and explicit full-limb verifier paths share arithmetic; their agreement is not two independent kernels.

remaining_obligations: No single measured grid combines all nine structured material classes with the full-limb producer. The distinct 13-arm and factorial grids have different challenge/timing scopes and cannot be merged into a universal minimum.
Actual setup reuse is measured at four searches and factorial 1/8/64 horizons; arbitrary batching, adaptive task/kernel dispatch and long-lived preprocessing remain unbounded.
Common task acquisition, failed whole-node admissions, encoding/transfer, PQ, M06 and durable settlement are not one complete acquisition denominator in these primitive campaigns.
Two hosted CPU architectures do not bound GPU/FPGA/ASIC, memory, energy or independent hardware/operator advantages.
Lottery/hardness and global cheapest legal work are unproved. Exact conditional q_eff is a sensitivity calculation, not a network adversarial share or finality probability.
40a's original four-second service pressure cases remain FAIL despite passing primitive cost observations; new integrated code and Chain/Hepta pair require their own native acceptance evidence.
